newsitem.title: USA: American Oilfield jackup sinks in Gulf.
newsitem.headline: American Oilfield jackup sinks in Gulf.

text.p: American Marine Construction said on Monday that its 150-foot jackup derrick barge, the American Intrepid, had sunk in 53 feet of water in the Gulf of Mexico at 0820 local time/1420 GMT on Sunday.
The rig started to list at 0600 local time, the company said.

"At about 8:20 am, the rig then sank in the Gulf of Mexico in approximately 50 feet of water, approximately seven miles south of Grand Isle, Louisiana," said the company, which is a subsidiary of American Oilfield Divers.
All crew were evacuated from the rig and the U.S. Coastgueard and the company are investigating the incident.
In March, the company won the National Ocean Industries award for safety at sea for the second year running.
